title: Properties of Cross-Entropy Loss
text: Cross-entropy loss is more sensitive to the differences between predicted probabilities and actual labels. How does this property help in classification tasks?

title: Gradient Descent and Loss Functions
text: Consider how the choice of loss function affects the convergence of gradient descent. Why might cross-entropy loss lead to better convergence properties?

hintAnswer: $$Cross-entropy$$ loss is preferred because it is more sensitive to the differences between predicted probabilities and actual labels, leading to better convergence properties in gradient descent.
